title: [Intro] Imaging specialist leveraging AI
content:
Hey,

Fellow Floridian (Weston) here, who moved to Sydney about 12 years ago.

I lead imaging teams working across multispectral imaging, photogrammetry, and traditional photography, documenting everything from slides of bacteria to rocket engines.

My background blends commercial production experience with heritage imaging best practices, which has put me in a unique position to identify software gaps (this is such a niche field) in my industry. The tools we need simply don't exist yet, or are spread across multiple solutions, require CLI knowledge most people don't have, or get blocked by IT policies that prevent installing random GitHub tools.

I'm currently studying CS on the side, so I have some understanding of engineering principles and tech stack fundamentals (TypeScript, Python, C, NodeJS, React), but the work that I need to do (and the fact that the landscape is evolving so fast), has led me to look into AI-assisted workflows in order to improve workflows from pre-production through hand-off to post-production, sometime before the decade is out.

What I'm looking to do (In no order of priority)

- Integration between robotic systems and software (automated capture systems based on object size (3 metres to 30+) that can work with our existing capture software- Full QA/Production suite: From metadata handling, barcode verification (via XML/Database connection), image analysis (distortion, focus, artefacts, etc), better renaming tools (anchor certain parts of filename i.e. with a 0001, 0002, 0003 suffix)- Image Training (we have millions of files and context data I can use to train) to deskew, identify people/places/things, crop, etc- High-end Stitching (based on focal length, object size, field of view, parallax, etc) - to work with the robotic system- Automatic (cross)updates of production status across Jira and digital asset management system- Develop a better calendar system for (or integrates with) Jira... (Jira Addon Pricing is an absolute rort. I require a simple add-on for 6 people, and am being charged for 100+)

title: Building vybecoding.ai with No Coding Experience
content:
Happy here! Here's a summary of my current project:

[vybecoding.ai](http://vybecoding.ai) - A platform where developers share quick AI building recipes and showcase what they've created.

What it is:
- Step-by-step guides showing exactly how to build things with AI (no fluff, just "here's how I built X in 30 minutes")
- Showcase of AI-generated websites/apps for inspiration
- Connect with other AI builders, find mentors, monetize your knowledge

The meta part:
I'm building the entire platform using AI (Claude Code + Augment), proving the concept it teaches.
It's AI all the way down, using AI to build a platform that teaches others to use AI.
The platform itself is proof that someone with minimal coding experience can ship realproducts.

Why it matters:
If I can build this with AI, anyone can build their ideas. No CS degree required, just the right tools and guides from people who've actually done it.

It's basically a recipe book + show-and-tell for AI builders but the cookbook was written by AI, about AI, for people using AI.

title: VAI EP 4: Background Agents, Design to Code Pipeline, Voice to Form Automation
content:
That was fun! Thanks to everyone who came out.

PDF summary attached

Takeaways:

- AI-assisted development can lead to frustration and inefficiencies. - Short prompts are more effective than lengthy instructions. - Building a community platform without looking at ANY OF THE CODE is challenging but insightful. - Context management is crucial for effective AI tool usage. - Different tools have varying strengths in handling context and prompts. - Design integration with AI tools is still a developing area. - Real-world applications of AI can significantly reduce manual work. - Iterative development and testing are essential for success with AI tools. - Collaboration and sharing experiences enhance learning in AI development. - The future of AI in development looks promising with ongoing advancements.
